#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int n = s.length();
    int ans = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int count = 1;
        while (i + 1 < n && s[i] == s[i + 1]) {
            count++;
            i++;
        }
        if (count % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
